cattle.label: Cattle

common_conditions.name: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD)
common_conditions.signs: Fever, drooling, vesicles/blisters on mouth, tongue, teats and feet, lameness
common_conditions.advice: Isolate animal, notify Block Veterinary Officer; FMD is a notifiable disease under NADCP

common_conditions.name: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD)
common_conditions.signs: Fever, multiple skin nodules, reduced milk yield, swollen lymph nodes
common_conditions.advice: Isolate; supportive care, antivirals under vet supervision; ring vaccination live around hotspots

common_conditions.name: Mastitis
common_conditions.signs: Swollen, hot, painful udder; abnormal/clotted milk; fever
common_conditions.advice: Separation + gentle milking, vet for antibiotic based on culture

common_conditions.name: Parasitic infection (worm burden)
common_conditions.signs: Weight loss, rough coat, pale gums, diarrhea, bottle jaw
common_conditions.advice: Deworm with approved anthelmintic; improve hygiene

common_conditions.name: Fever / Generalized illness
common_conditions.signs: Dullness, anorexia, high rectal temperature, drop in rumination
common_conditions.advice: Record temperature daily; consult MVU quickly

cattle.care_tips: Clean dry housing, regular deworming, neck-tag vaccination schedule, green fodder + mineral supplement
cattle.helpline_note: Report notifiable diseases to helpline 1962 or nearest State Veterinary Dispensary

buffalo.label: Buffalo

common_conditions.name: FMD
common_conditions.signs: Same as cattle - fever, mouth blisters, lameness, drooling
common_conditions.advice: Isolate, notify vet; notifiable disease

common_conditions.name: Brucellosis
common_conditions.signs: Abortion storms, retained placenta, infertility, arthritis
common_conditions.advice: Test herd, cull positive, vaccinate calves (B. abortus strain-19/B5)

common_conditions.name: Haemorrhagic septicaemia (HS)
common_conditions.signs: High fever, swelling of throat/neck, respiratory distress, sudden death
common_conditions.advice: Emergency - call mobile vet unit; vaccination best prevention

common_conditions.name: Trypanosomiasis / Surra
common_conditions.signs: Intermittent fever, anemia, edema, abortion
common_conditions.advice: Blood smear by vet; treat with trypanocide

buffalo.care_tips: Wallowing area, shade, mineral lick; regular HS & FMD vaccination
buffalo.helpline_note: Call 1962 / MVU for suspected HS or anthrax immediately

goat.label: Goat / Sheep (Small Ruminant)

common_conditions.name: PPR (Goat Plague)
common_conditions.signs: High fever, ocular-nasal discharge, necrotic mouth lesions, diarrhea
common_conditions.advice: Isolate; supportive care; PPR vaccine available free under govt programs

common_conditions.name: Peste des petits ruminants
common_conditions.signs: Same as above (synonym of PPR)
common_conditions.advice: Notify vet; control spread in flock

common_conditions.name: Internal parasites
common_conditions.signs: Bottle jaw (edema under jaw), pale conjunctiva, diarrhea, emaciation
common_conditions.advice: FAMACHA scoring by vet; targeted deworming

common_conditions.name: Enterotoxaemia (pulpy kidney)
common_conditions.signs: Sudden death in well-fed kids; convulsions, scouring
common_conditions.advice: Vaccination; dietary consistency

goat.care_tips: Elevated clean housing, foot care, both major viral vaccines (PPR, ET), mineral salt block
goat.helpline_note: PPR is notifiable - report to 1962 / state AH department

pig.label: Pig (Swine)

common_conditions.name: African Swine Fever (ASF)
common_conditions.signs: High fever, sudden death, blood-tinged diarrhea, skin redness/cyanosis
common_conditions.advice: NOTIFIABLE - immediate quarantine & inform District Vet Officer; movement ban may apply

common_conditions.name: Classical Swine Fever (CSF)
common_conditions.signs: Fever, lethargy, conjunctivitis, skin hemorrhage, constipation then diarrhea
common_conditions.advice: Vaccination; biosecurity; report suspicious deaths

common_conditions.name: Swine erysipelas
common_conditions.signs: Diamond-shaped skin lesions, fever, sudden death
common_conditions.advice: Vet antibiotics; hygiene

pig.care_tips: Strict biosecurity, no swill feeding of uncooked meat, regular footbath, vaccination
pig.helpline_note: ASF movement ban zones are active - check Cases module before transport

poultry.label: Poultry / Birds

common_conditions.name: Avian Influenza (H5N1)
common_conditions.signs: Sudden high mortality, swollen head/comb/wattles, cyanosis, greenish diarrhea
common_conditions.advice: NOTIFIABLE - culling zone may apply; report immediately to helpline 1962 / District Vet

common_conditions.name: Newcastle Disease (Ranikhet)
common_conditions.signs: Respiratory distress, twisting neck, green diarrhea, drop in egg production
common_conditions.advice: Vaccination (Lasota/R2B); strict biosecurity

common_conditions.name: Coccidiosis
common_conditions.signs: Bloody droppings, ruffled feathers, anemia, poor growth
common_conditions.advice: Anticoccidial in feed/water; dry litter management

common_conditions.name: Infectious bursal disease (Gumboro)
common_conditions.signs: Sudden mortality in chicks, vent-pecking, watery white diarrhea
common_conditions.advice: Vaccinate; hygiene

poultry.care_tips: Litter management, adequate ventilation, all-in-all-out system, vaccination schedule per age
poultry.helpline_note: Any unusual poultry die-off must be reported - AI is in culling zone status in parts of India

dog.label: Dog / Canine

common_conditions.name: Canine Distemper
common_conditions.signs: Fever, nasal/ocular discharge, diarrhea, twitching, fits, hard pad disease
common_conditions.advice: Vet consult; supportive care; vaccination core protection

common_conditions.name: Parvovirus
common_conditions.signs: Vomiting, fetid bloody diarrhea, lethargy, dehydration
common_conditions.advice: Emergency - IV fluids + vet care; vaccinate

common_conditions.name: Rabies (exposure risk)
common_conditions.signs: Behavior change, salivation, paralysis, hydrophobia
common_conditions.advice: Human safety first - if bitten, wash wound & post-exposure vaccine; animal quarantine

common_conditions.name: Skin / parasite (mange, ticks)
common_conditions.signs: Hair loss, itching, crusts, tick infestation
common_conditions.advice: Ectoparasite control + vet topical/scab treatment

dog.care_tips: Rabies vaccine yearly, deworming, balanced diet, leash + ID tag
dog.helpline_note: Suspected rabies = treat as public health emergency, contact helpline 1962 / district AH

cat.label: Cat / Feline

common_conditions.name: Feline Panleukopenia (FPV)
common_conditions.signs: High fever, vomiting, diarrhea, dehydration, sudden death in kittens
common_conditions.advice: Emergency vet care; vaccination

common_conditions.name: Feline Respiratory complex (URI)
common_conditions.signs: Sneezing, conjunctivitis, nasal discharge, mouth ulcers
common_conditions.advice: Vet supportive care; vaccination (FVRCP)

common_conditions.name: Skin/ear mites & fleas
common_conditions.signs: Intense scratching, hair loss, dark ear debris
common_conditions.advice: Parasite control products from vet; clean environment

cat.care_tips: Indoor safety, FVRCP wear, deworming, litter hygiene

wildlife.label: Wildlife

common_conditions.name: Anthrax (herbivore risk)
common_conditions.signs: Sudden death with blood from orifices, bloating
common_conditions.advice: Do NOT open carcass - contact Forest+AH dept; human risk

common_conditions.name: Injury / trauma (roadkill, snare)
common_conditions.signs: Limping, wounds, bleeding
common_conditions.advice: Report to forest department rescue team

common_conditions.name: Malnutrition / emaciation
common_conditions.signs: Prominent ribs, dull coat, weakness
common_conditions.advice: Report; do not approach - wildlife handling requires permits

wildlife.care_tips: Do not approach or feed wild animals; report via forest department helpline
wildlife.helpline_note: Wildlife emergencies: State Forest Dept + helpline 1962 for zoonotic risk

fish.label: Fish / Aquatic

common_conditions.name: Epizootic Ulcerative Syndrome (EUS)
common_conditions.signs: Red/hemorrhagic skin ulcers, gray rotten areas, lethargy
common_conditions.advice: Check water quality; isolate affected pond; sodium chloride + vet advice

common_conditions.name: Columnaris / fungal & bacterial
common_conditions.signs: Cotton-wool growths, frayed fins, gill damage, surface gasping
common_conditions.advice: Water quality correction; approved treatments

common_conditions.name: Low dissolved oxygen (asphyxia)
common_conditions.signs: Surface gasping, death at dawn, morning kills
common_conditions.advice: Aeration, reduce stocking, check plankton bloom

fish.care_tips: Monitor DO, pH, ammonia daily; species-specific stocking density

disclaimer: AI-assisted screening only — not a veterinary diagnosis. Always confirm with a registered veterinary officer and the national helpline 1962.
